SLOOS Survey Charts

8 charts

SLOOS: C&I Standards, Net % Tightening

Net percentage of banks reporting tighter C&I loan standards; higher means credit supply is tighter.

SLOOS: C&I Demand, Net % Stronger

Net percentage of banks reporting stronger C&I loan demand; higher means borrower demand improved.

SLOOS: C&I Loan Spreads, Net % Widening

Net percentage of banks increasing loan-rate spreads over funding costs; higher means terms are tighter.

SLOOS: CRE Standards, Net % Tightening

Net percentage of banks tightening CRE standards across construction, multifamily, and nonfarm nonresidential loans.

SLOOS: CRE Demand, Net % Stronger

Net percentage of banks reporting stronger demand for the main CRE lending categories.

SLOOS: Consumer Standards, Net % Tightening

Net percentage of banks tightening credit card, auto, and other consumer-loan standards.

SLOOS: Consumer Demand, Net % Stronger

Net percentage of banks reporting stronger demand across credit card, auto, and other consumer loans.

SLOOS: Willingness to Make Consumer Loans

Net percentage of banks more willing to make consumer installment loans, shown against the 10Y-3M spread.
